name: AirPods Pro 2 Clone White
subtitle: White wireless earbuds with charging case
description: AirPods Pro 2 Clone White are true wireless earbuds with a stem-style in-ear design, Bluetooth connectivity, touch controls, and an integrated microphone. Each charge provides up to four hours of playback, while the charging case offers up to 12–15 hours of total backup.
story: The compact charging case keeps both earbuds together for storage and recharging between listening sessions. Touch-sensitive controls allow basic playback and call handling directly from the earbuds, while Bluetooth connectivity supports compatible Android phones, iPhones, tablets, and laptops. The white stem-style design shown matches the supplied product image. No active noise cancellation, charging connector type, Bluetooth version, water-resistance rating, or exact audio specifications are verified, so those details are not claimed here.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
